name: Neon Velocity
shortDescription: High-octane cyber runner with stunning neon visuals, power-ups, combo system, and addictive "one more try" gameplay. Dodge obstacles, collect energy orbs, and survive as long as you can!

generation.notes: Action-packed endless runner with cyberpunk aesthetic, 4 power-up types, combo multiplier system, particle effects, and responsive touch/keyboard controls.
